source.title: African Crop Calendar: A geo-referenced dataset of crop growing seasons across diverse agro-ecological regions in Sub-Saharan Africa
source.publisher: Katharina Waha, Sophie Rötzer, Koen De Vos, Uwe Grewer, Andrew Tomes, and Altaaf Mechiche-Alami
source.geographicScope: Nigeria survey sample, grouped from published admin-level-3 LGA names matched to exact canonical state and LGA names. These records are not representative estimates, field-specific advice, or a planting advisory.
source.notes: Derived from the published AfricanCropCalendar CSV. Aggregated by canonical LGA, simplified crop, activity period, and month; each evidence count is the number of source plot records. Survey wave year labels are retained. Unmatched administrative names, unidentified crops, and missing or invalid months are excluded rather than guessed. The authors describe this as harmonised household survey data; LGA grouping does not imply a representative LGA estimate.
